question: In India, _________ was the final approval authority for the five year plans.
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Development Council.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Development Council (NDC)** was the** final approval authority **for the five year plans in India.
 
• The NDC was established in **August 1952 **as a **non-statutory body **to facilitate coordination between the** Centre and the States **on matters of **national development.**
 
• **The Prime Minister of India** was the** ex-officio chairman **of the NDC, and the members included **Cabinet Ministers, Chief Ministers of States, and experts** from various fields.
 
• The NDC played a crucial role in** formulating and implementing **the** five year plans**, which aimed at achieving **rapid economic growth, social justice, and self-reliance.**
 
• The International Development Council, National Agriculture and Development Council, and National Development Centre are **not valid options** as they are not relevant to the context and **do not exist** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• The **five year plans** were a series of **national development plans** that were initiated by the** Indian government** after independence in **1947.**
 
• The **first five year plan** was launched in** 1951**, and a total of **12 plans** were implemented until **2017.**
 
• The five year plans focused on various sectors such as **agriculture, industry, infrastructure, education, health, and social welfare.**
 
• The five year plans were based on the principles of **democratic socialism**, which emphasized the role of the state in **promoting economic growth** and **social welfare.**
 
• Hence, the statement "The National Development Council was the final approval authority for the five year plans in India" is **correct.**
